recap: Family, buckle up — episode two gave us a Tribal Council for the ages. Toka came in banged up, with Brady chopping the tip of his thumb clean off and begging the doc to let him stay, and they still swept the day: reward AND immunity. Over on Savu, the "Persian sisters" plan between Alexis and Ana cracked wide open. Ana threw out a decoy name, then threw out her OWN name, and Alexis took that intel straight to Sharonda and Linnea. Meanwhile Eric — the consensus boot for three days — got scooped up as a free number. And Rob? Rob tried to idol Eric back to life and vote himself out of this game, until he learned you can't do that. So the plan died, the blindside landed, and Ana went home 6-4 with Carter, Rob and Ori left in the dark. Big moves, big mess, big fun.
bullets: Brady's thumb nearly ended his game — doctor cleared him, and Toka swept reward and immunity anyway.
Jelly found an idol with no beware, no strings, and immediately made Patt her new number one.
Kristin hurt her leg in the nets and whipped up a natural remedy from the local plants — that's resourceful.
Rob's plan to idol Eric and self-vote collapsed when production told him self-voting isn't a thing.
Ana suggested her own name as a decoy, and the tribe said: don't mind if we do.
draftImpact: Tami, Tim and Austin all picked up four and all your people are still breathing — Tami at a perfect 5 of 5, Tim 4 of 4, Austin 4 of 4. Taylor, you gained three but lost Ana in the blindside, so you're sitting at 7 with 3 of 4 left. Kylie, you added three to reach 6 with 3 of 4 standing. That makes it a three-way tie atop the board: Austin, Tami, Tim, all at 8. Taylor, Kylie — the game is long.
